description: Combination semantics of the decision profile v1alpha1 (docs/contracts/module-contract-v0.1.md, section 6). Each case is one bundle for agent_id holding the listed policies and the catalog file catalog (section 7.7), one AuthZEN request and the expected response. A request inside the profile whose resource is a tool or a model names an entry of the catalog by its key, with the properties that the catalog gives it (section 6.3), and the record of a tool call holds only arguments that the entry declares, each of its declared type (section 6.11). The response carries bundle_version, the version of the case's bundle, with policy.permit, policy.forbid, policy.no_permit and error.evaluation, and may carry it or not with error.unknown_agent and error.invalid_request (section 6.6). valid says whether the policy passes the validator against the profile's Cedar schema, with the ToolArgs that the core generates from the catalog: one optional record per tool that declares arguments, keyed by the tool's key, with each argument under its name and of its type (section 6.7). A request that a case refuses with error.invalid_request does not match decision-request.schema.json, unless the case's rule names the rule of the profile, outside the schema, that refuses it: another_agent, an agent action that names another agent (section 6.3); another_tool, a tool call whose arguments hold another tool's record rather than its own (section 6.4); not_an_integer, an argument that is not a signed 64-bit integer written without a fraction or an exponent (section 6.4); or invalid_time, a time that does not exist (section 1).

cases.description: An agent-specific permit allows
A global permit allows
A global forbid overrides an agent-specific permit
An agent-specific forbid overrides a global permit

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"model.invoke", resource)
when { resource.provider != "ollama" };

cases.description: Nothing applies: denied by default
A permit for another action does not apply
A forbid whose condition does not hold does not apply
Conditions on the agent's data categories: external model forbidden

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"model.invoke", resource)
when { principal.data_categories.contains("customer data") && resource.provider != "ollama" };

cases.description: Conditions on the agent's data categories: local model allowed

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"model.invoke", resource)
when { principal.data_categories.contains("customer data") && resource.provider != "ollama" };

cases.description: Conditions on labels, which are entity tags

policies.text:
permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource == WhiteTower::Tool::"agent/post_ledger")
when { principal.hasTag("team") && principal.getTag("team") == "finance" };

cases.description: Conditions on time: inside the permitted hours

policies.text:
permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource == WhiteTower::Tool::"agent/post_ledger")
when { context.time.toTime() >= duration("7h") && context.time.toTime() < duration("19h") };

cases.description: Conditions on time: outside the permitted hours

policies.text:
permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource == WhiteTower::Tool::"agent/post_ledger")
when { context.time.toTime() >= duration("7h") && context.time.toTime() < duration("19h") };

cases.description: Every permit that applies determines an allow

policies.text: permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource) when { resource.kind == "function" };

cases.description: An evaluation error denies, even when a permit applies
The environment that registration returns decides

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource == WhiteTower::Tool::"agent/post_ledger")
when { principal.environment == "non_production" };

A request with a member that the profile does not have is outside it
on_behalf_of makes a request invalid, set to a principal

on_behalf_of makes a request invalid, even null

Determining policies are listed in ascending order, whatever their order in the bundle

cases.description: A request for another agent is refused as such, even when it is outside the profile too
A subject that is not an agent is refused as an unknown agent, before the profile is checked
A time that does not exist, February 29 of a year that is not a leap year, is outside the profile

cases.description: A trace ID followed by a line break is outside the profile: the $ of the schema's patterns matches at the end of the string only, as ECMA-262 reads it
A request without its context is outside the profile
A resource ID of 513 characters is outside the profile: agent/, 506 letters a, then U+1D49C

A resource ID of 512 characters is inside the profile: agent/, 505 letters a, then U+1D49C, which takes 4 bytes in UTF-8 and 2 code units in UTF-16, so that a stack that counts 515 bytes or 513 code units refuses it
A policy names a whole MCP server: an MCP tool is in its server

policies.text: permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource in WhiteTower::McpServer::"github");

cases.description: A tool that no MCP server provides is in no server

policies.text: permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource in WhiteTower::McpServer::"github");

cases.description: The catalog's classification of a tool decides: a destructive tool that is not read-only is forbidden

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource)
when { resource.destructive && !resource.read_only };

cases.description: A built-in tool has its provider, and the origin of a provider-run tool

policies.text:
permit (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.invoke", resource)
when { resource.kind == "builtin" && resource.origin == "provider" && resource has provider && resource.provider == "openai" };

cases.description: An exposure whose calls are not decided is forbidden by a policy that needs them decided

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.expose", resource == WhiteTower::Tool::"github/create_pull_request")
unless { context.calls_decided };

cases.description: An exposure whose calls are decided is permitted by the global permit

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"tool.expose", resource == WhiteTower::Tool::"github/create_pull_request")
unless { context.calls_decided };

cases.description: An exposure without calls_decided is outside the profile
calls_decided on a tool call is outside the profile
A model call carries the digest that the runtime reports

policies.text:
forbid (principal, action == WhiteTower::Action::"model.invoke", resource)
unless { context has digest && context.digest == "sha256:8754b77c7eee26e4145b5d20073c32e595c3ecb1a1a7d257df257479ab27c7cf" };
